reason: The description gives no voltage or current, so it fits any of the BMS PCBAs; at $5.24 on a service PO, BMS-19554 ($3.92 from Suntronix) is about 1.34x production, within the 2x spares allowance, while BMS-19545 and BMS-19537 (~$2.5-2.6) would need slightly over 2x, and BMS-19562 is from a different supplier.
